# Stockfish.js WASM asset

The unmodified, single-threaded Lite engine files in this folder are from the official Stockfish.js `v19.0.1` release:

- https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js/releases/tag/v19.0.1
- Engine source archive: `stockfish.js-v19.0.1-source.tar.gz`
- GPLv3 license text: `Copying.txt`

The app loads `stockfish-19-lite-single.js` and its matching `.wasm` locally in a Web Worker. Stockfish is GPL-3.0; retain this notice and source archive when sharing a copy of the app.
